items.title: Kalshi: Fed decision in October?
items.claim: At 13:37 UTC, the page displayed 55% for “Hike 25bps,” 45% for “Fed maintains rate,” and 1% for “Hike >25bps,” with two more outcomes hidden.

items.title: Polymarket: Fed Decision in October?
items.claim: At 13:37 UTC, direct outcome rows displayed 56% for a 25 bp increase and 44% for no change; rules define outcomes using the upper-bound target-range change and name the October FOMC statement as resolution source.
